skirmish.module.boss_coach.name: Boss Coach
skirmish.module.boss_coach.description: While a HolyWorld boss bar is on screen: the phase by health percent, tips from the wiki, and your share of the damage with DPS. Read-only: the boss bar and server-confirmed hits.
skirmish.module.boss_coach.setting.phase: The current phase by health percent and what the boss does in it (from the wiki)
How to deal with the boss, from its wiki description
skirmish.module.boss_coach.setting.meter: Your share of the boss bar's drop right after your hits, and your damage per second. An estimate: in a crowd, others' damage at the same moment counts as yours
skirmish.module.boss_coach.setting.attri: A bar drop within this time after your hit counts as yours
skirmish.module.boss_coach.setting.dps_w: How many recent seconds the damage per second covers
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.suicider.tip: Charged creeper: blasts and knocks far back. Summons exploding creepers, so don't bunch up
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.kung_fu.tip: Hits hard when landing from a jump, so step away. Comes with many ice archers
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.rooster.tip: Blindness IV now and then. Exploding chickens around
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.karlson.tip: Flies, so elytra help a lot. Poisons; baby zombies with knockback sticks guard him
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.mad_cow.tip: Cows reflect damage. The madness spreads to other cows: find the mad one and keep track of it
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.ice_troll.tip: Blindness II, Poison II, Slowness IV. Summons ice archers, knockback zombies and snow golems
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.leonardo.tip: Launches you into the air once you start hitting him
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.leonardo.phase.1: Weak damage: hit him down to half
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.leonardo.phase.2: Three turtles: while they live the boss takes no damage, kill them first
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.illusionist.tip: Illusions take no damage, find the real one. Shoots a bow
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.speedrunner.tip: Huge damage; Blindness II, Mining Fatigue II and Slowness II nearby. Small zombie swordsmen with him
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.wanderer.tip: Lots of bad effects, knocks back, can turn invisible and slip away. Spawns witches and angry golems
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.deathbringer.tip: Wither skeleton in netherite: lethal up close, keep him away
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.coat_horse.tip: Reflects damage and effects, knocks back and runs. Brute piglins with him
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.louse.tip: Nausea II. A swarm of silverfish can bite you to death
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.potter.tip: Summons vexes, slimes, magma cubes, charged creepers, ravagers and brute piglins
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.slippery_joe.tip: Lethal damage but clumsy. Nausea and Slowness II; spawns smaller slimes
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.baba_yaga.tip: Reflects damage, touching her hitbox kills: keep your distance. Dolphins riding bats explode
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.detonator.tip: Keeps away. With several players nearby it hisses, explodes and teleports behind a random one
Stops, immune to knockback; a rain of lit TNT
Tower of four creepers mid-arena: hitting the lower ones gives thorns. Invulnerable charged creepers
Big charged creeper chases the top 3 by damage and always explodes after hissing. Creepers riding cats
Every ability at once, far more minions
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.air_lord.tip: Hits harder on high-damage or armoured players. A crowd nearby makes it invulnerable: it rises and rains projectiles
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.air_lord.phase.2: Waves of 12–16 flyers: blazes, breezes, phantoms
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.air_lord.phase.3: Vexes and poisoning bees; bats chase the top 3 by damage and explode
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.air_lord.phase.4: Twice as active, every minion at once
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.tough_nuts.tip: Two golems: when their health drifts apart the weaker turns invulnerable, so split damage evenly
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.tough_nuts.phase: The iron one attacks, switching targets; the copper one stays close
A snow golem every 6–8 s: snowballs deal a heart through armour and knock ~10 blocks back
Snow golems every 10–12 s; every 30–32 s a crowd of golems, ravagers and zoglins
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.devilry.tip: A creaking whose hits ignore armour
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.devilry.phase.1: Eyes dark: 30% chance to hit back (2.5 hearts, 10–15 block knockback); a minion every 8–12 s
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.devilry.phase.2: Eyes lit: faster, attacks on its own (2.5–3.5 hearts); 3–4 strong minions every 8–10 s
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.alien.tip: Never attacks itself: effects and minions, sometimes invulnerable
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.alien.phase.2: Every 45–60 s digs (invulnerable), then 15–20 minions. When it sniffs, hitters get Slow Falling and Jump Boost III
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.alien.phase.3: Thorns III at 25%. Every 25–30 s shulkers, endermen and endermites (infection for a minute)
skirmish.bosscoach.boss.keeper.tip: A buffed ominous Warden. The top 3 by damage are rewarded; Ancient City blocks cannot be broken or placed
